purpose: Teach: 従軍/感受性/故人/発砲/怠っ/氾濫/乱用/断絶

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者、若い頃、従軍経験、ある、苦労された方だ、本当に、お父さんの世代の、本当に、大変だった時代、絶対、社員、伝えていけ、本当に、頼んだぞ、本気で、絶対、これは。
lines.en: The founder, in his youth, experienced military service, endured genuine hardship. My father's generation lived through truly difficult times. You must convey this to the staff — convey it absolutely. I'm serious. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Deliberate pacing on the founder's legacy. Weight on 「絶対」. A man speaking from conviction earned over decades, not performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、感受性、本当に、大事に、しております、当社の文化、心を、大切にする、企業、目指しております、本当に、社長、ご安心ください、絶対、本気で、絶対、本当に、社員、皆。
lines.en: Yes. The sensitivity of our staff — we truly treasure it. We aim to be a company that cherishes the heart in our culture. Please be assured, President. We mean this absolutely. I give you my word. Every single member of staff.
lines.style: Steady, formal register. Careful articulation on each commitment. Slight breath-pause before "Please be assured" — this is his reassurance, not his nervousness. Even cadence, like a man reading from his own conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 故人となった創業者、本当に、お父さんが、お祖父ちゃんを、亡くされた時のこと、覚えております、絶対、お祖父ちゃんの遺志、当社の、礎、これからも、絶対、引き継いでいけ、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: The founder has passed away now. I remember when my father lost his grandfather. I remember it clearly. His grandfather's will became the foundation of this company. We must continue to inherit that legacy going forward — absolutely. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective than before. Slow, careful on the personal memory — "I remember it clearly" carries a small weight. Steady voice but with the gravity of inheritance, not urgency. Trailing calm at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、絶対、暴力的、発砲のような事件、起きないよう、徹底的に、防犯、進めております、本当に、社員、皆、安全、第一に、考えております、本気で、絶対、本気、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We are implementing rigorous security measures to ensure that violent incidents — anything like that — never occur within our company. Every staff member's safety is our first priority. We are completely serious about this commitment.
lines.style: Professional, systematic tone. Each measure stated with quiet assurance. No overstatement — just clear recitation of what's being done. Firm on "safety is our first priority." The voice of someone who has thought this through completely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 安全管理を、怠った企業、業界で、本当に、信用、失っているな、当社、絶対、そうならないように、徹底だ、社員、皆、本気で、頑張れ、本当に、頼んだぞ、絶対、これは、本気で。
lines.en: Companies that have neglected safety management have lost trust in this industry. This company will not become one of them. We will be thorough — absolutely thorough. Staff, give your best effort on this. I'm counting on you. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Sharp, directive tone with measured intensity. A quick beat of emphasis on 「絶対」. Not angry, but unmistakably firm. The voice of someone drawing a clear line, not negotiating it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報の氾濫の中で、当社の正しい、ブランドメッセージ、本気で、発信、続けてまいります、お客様、本気で、信頼、いただけるよう、社員、頑張ります、絶対、本気で、本当に、絶対、頼みます。
lines.en: Yes. In the midst of information flooding the market, we will continue to send out our brand's correct message with conviction. We will work so that our customers can trust us completely. Every staff member will do their part. We mean this sincerely.
lines.style: Forward-looking, purposeful tone. Steady build toward the commitment to customers. Breath-space before "Every staff member" — this is his earnest rally. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Resolute but not harsh.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: コンプラ違反、権限乱用、当社、絶対、許さない方針、社員、徹底しろ、本気だぞ、絶対、頼んだぞ、これは、絶対、本気で、本当に、社員、皆、絶対、覚えておけ、絶対。
lines.en: Compliance violations, abuse of authority — this company will not tolerate them. Not ever. Staff, make sure you understand this thoroughly. I am serious. You must remember this. Every single one of you. This is absolute.
lines.style: Sharp, unambiguous. Staccato on the violations — no room for interpretation. Heavy emphasis on each 「絶対」. The voice drops slightly to ensure weight. Not loud, but carrying undeniable authority. A line being drawn.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様との、絶対、断絶、避けるよう、本気で、対応、続けてまいります、絶対、長い、お付き合い、本気で、続けてまいります、お父さんから、本当に、頼まれた、約束です、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We will work to avoid any breach with our valued clients. We will continue to respond seriously to their needs. We will maintain these long relationships with genuine care. This is a promise I was asked to keep — a promise from my father. Absolutely.
lines.style: Warm sincerity beneath formality. Slower pace, lingering gently on "long relationships." The word 「約束」(promise) carries personal weight — he means it. Quiet, steady close. Not rushed. The voice of someone honoring a commitment made long ago.
